patch_list: Clean Authentication
Removes the unavailable phone sign-in controls while keeping Google and Apple sign-in.
Clean Home
Removes store/brand carousels and promotional banners from the Home tab, with an optional shortcut-row cleanup.
Configure Shortcuts
Customizes items displayed in the Your Shortcuts carousel.
Enable App Debugging
Marks the app debuggable so patch developers can use ADB run-as after reinstalling.
Hide Sezzle Mobile
Hides Sezzle Mobile offers and account entry points.
Patch Consent Screen
Requires consent to a patched-app warning before opening Sezzle authentication.
Remove Ads and Tracking

Removes ads (AppLovin MAX, Google Mobile Ads, Thanks network, Playtime, InBrain Surveys) and disables analytics and tracking SDKs (AppsFlyer, FullStory, Braze, Firebase Analytics, mParticle, Facebook SDK, AppCenter).
Remove Promos & Giveaways
Blocks in-app deal popups, giveaway screens, Knot card-linking dialogs, and marketing banners across the app.
Remove Rewards
Removes the Rewards bottom navigation tab while keeping Account's Sezzle Points item accessible.
Remove Sezzle Subscriptions
Removes references to Sezzle Anywhere and Sezzle Premium subscriptions in Account benefits, the Home gift card carousel, Wallet, and Orders help.
Rename Shop to Home
Renames the Shop bottom navigation tab to Home.
Replace AI Discover with Products
Replaces the AI Discover navigation tab with Sezzle's original non-AI Products tab and removes the Sezzle AI callout in search. Includes an option to remove the Products tab completely.
Suppress In-App Updates and Rating Prompts
Neutralizes Hermes Redux update sagas, UpdateAppModal dialogs, Play Store URL redirects, trustFall tamper detection, and in-app rating prompts.
Unlock Custom App Icons
Enables custom launcher app icons (Arctic, Peach, Glass, Rainbow, Sand, Classic) without requiring a Sezzle Premium subscription.
Unlock Developer Settings
Makes the internal Development Settings menu visible to every signed-in account.
Unlock Receipt Scanner
Makes the receipt scanner available from Development Settings and forces its V2 flow to render. REQUIRES Unlock Developer Settings to be enabled.
